🎥🎬: Family Plan 2 (2025)

Dan Morgan is pulled back into danger when what should be a relaxing family getaway turns into another unexpected mission. Hoping to enjoy some quality time with his wife and children, Dan soon discovers that escaping his former life as a highly trained assassin isn’t as easy as he thought.

With dangerous enemies closing in, Dan must once again rely on his old skills while trying to keep his family safe. But this time, the Morgans are more prepared for the chaos, turning their vacation into a wild mix of family drama, comedy, and explosive action.

Starring Mark Wahlberg, The Family Plan 2 continues the Morgan family’s story with bigger adventures, unexpected trouble, and the reminder that family always comes first.
